questions.question: Explain Herbert Spencer’s contribution to evolutionary sociology.
questions.solution_html:
• Herbert Spencer applied Darwin’s theory of evolution to society
  • explaining progress through adaptation. His ideas formed the basis of
  • social evolutionism and differentiation.

questions.question: State one difference between dialectics and metaphysics.
questions.solution_html:
• / Dialectics stresses contradictions and social change, while
  • metaphysics focuses on static, abstract reasoning detached from material
  • reality.
